summary: The common Arch image helper permits an explicit scratch directory only as closed TMPDIR. The directory must already exist, be empty, owned by the invoking uid, mode0700, tmpfs-backed and disjoint from sources, acquisition, state, storage and engine namespace paths; its device/inode identity is rechecked before effects. Keep libpod --tmpdir and the retained graph/run roots stable. Buildah context-overlay scaffolding uses TMPDIR even with VFS image storage, so VFS alone does not establish acceptable scratch backing. The helper creates, mounts and deletes no scratch allocation; allocation ownership remains external. TMPDIR can also hold image-copy and complete OCI layout staging; count tmpfs pages in shared memory and disk/inode budgets rather than actor RSS alone. Static guards and intercepted engine controls establish source behavior, while actual kernel/build/export/cleanup acceptance still requires its separate bounded native qualification. This boundary does not grant publication, defaults, database reset or any runtime operation.
title: Separate common image scratch from persistent engine paths
